verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only piecemeal paths out of WorkOS. Audit log events can be exported or streamed to a SIEM, directory data can be retrieved via the Events API, and a public OpenAPI spec and MCP server give programmatic read access to dashboard data such as users, organizations and connections. There is no documented one-step export of all data in open formats; the Auth0 guide covers migrating into WorkOS, not out of it, and a community user's open question about how to export login data and switch away remains unanswered in the evidence. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, open-format export of users/credentials/SSO connections, an outbound migration guide or portability guarantees, and independent hands-on confirmation of leaving.
